question: 官方源码/测试能否证明 Gemini CLI 在 S4 未知的崩溃恢复、重复调用、idempotentHint、resume 与 exactly-once 方面具有什么语义？

claims.claim: Tool responses and completed tool calls are recorded with durable IDs and linear history metadata for resume.

sources.support: recordSyntheticMessage and recordCompletedToolCalls persist IDs, args, results, statuses and timestamps.

claims.caveat: Durable history is not durable remote side-effect state.

claims.claim: A resumed session ending with an unanswered tool response is structurally repaired when a new user message arrives; this does not automatically rerun the tool.

sources.support: closeUnansweredToolResponseTurn is invoked before recording a new non-function-response message.
Test explicitly covers dangling tool response restored from resumed session.

claims.claim: Model stream retry re-calls the content generator and a test verifies successful text history is not duplicated; this does not prove tool execution exactly-once.

sources.support: streamWithRetries loops attempts and yields RETRY before another API call.
Retry test expects generator twice and history length two with one successful response.

claims.caveat: The tested unit is model stream, not shell/MCP side effect.

claims.claim: MCP idempotentHint is preserved as tool annotations; this slice found no use for scheduler deduplication, automatic retry, transaction or exactly-once.

sources.support: Test checks registeredTool.toolAnnotations includes idempotentHint true.

claims.caveat: Absence finding bounded to fixed official baseline.

claims.claim: Checkpoint data includes commitHash, histories, toolCall and messageId; restore is project/history rollback plus re-proposal, not proven remote transaction rollback.

sources.support: ToolCallData schema and snapshot processing store these fields.
Official restore description reverts files/history and re-proposes original tool.

claims.caveat: External side effects outside shadow Git are out of scope of shown restore.

claims.claim: The fixed official source/tests do not prove crash/disconnect uncertain-result resolution, exactly-once, idempotency keys or remote rollback.
claims.caveat: Bounded absence-of-evidence finding, not a universal claim about every future version or unsearched implementation.

unresolved_conflicts: No direct source conflict; durable history/retry exists but exactly-once remote side-effect guarantee remains unproven.
